messages:
sam: Hey team — hitting a couple onboarding access blockers. My GCP project (proj-redwood-sam) can’t create resources in asia-northeast1 (403 denied). I also don’t see the billing account to attach the project. Can someone point me to the right org/billing role or who to ping?

leah: @sam welcome! most likely an org policy or billing linkage issue. Do you see a specific error message when you try to create the VM or subnet? paste the exact error if possible. :wave:

sam: Error from gcloud: 
```
ERROR: (gcloud.compute.instances.create) PERMISSION_DENIED: The resource could not be written.
Details: Policy 'constraints/compute.restrictRegions' prevents this operation.
```
And when I go to IAM -> Billing, the project shows "No billing account linked" and I don’t have permission to link it.

mika: That policy is set at org/folder level to restrict regions to [us-central1, europe-west1] for prod-sensitive org units. New hires usually get a sandbox quota in "dev-sandbox" folder. Are you under the right folder? Can you share the full project number (PM if sensitive).

sam: Project number is 9876543210. I’m under the personal onboarding folder I think. Not sure of the folder id.

ashley: @sam I raised a small access ticket: INFRA-8421 to add you to the onboarding-folder and attach the dev billing account. Steps I’ll run: 1) add project to folder onboarding-dev, 2) link billing account billingAccounts/0123-4567-89, 3) add `roles/billing.projectManager` to your user so you can link in future. ETA ~30m.

leo: Quick security note — region relaxations require justification for projects that will store customer data. Ashley, if this is just dev sandbox for onboarding, we’re fine. If not, @sam plz confirm no customer data.

sam: Confirmed — test datasets only, no customer data.

infra-bot: Deployment policy check: project 9876543210 currently denies compute in asia-northeast1 due to `constraints/compute.restrictRegions` at folder level (onboarding-folder). Ticket INFRA-8421 created and assigned to ashley.

ashley: Update: added project to onboarding-dev folder and linked billing account. You should now be able to create resources in allowed regions (us/eu). I didn’t open asia-northeast1 because org policy still disallows it. If you need asia region specifically, we need an exception — please file a short justification in the ticket or ping me.

sam: Thanks! One more — I also need AWS cross-account role to assume into the infra account to run terraform state migrations. My AWS Console shows no "Switch Role" target for `redwood-infra`. Who should I ask?

leah: For AWS assume-role, file an access request in SSO with target role arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/rdw-dev-terraform. Tag it "onboarding - sam" and include your Okta email. Ops team usually approves within an hour. If blocked, ping @mika or @ashley.

mika: Also make sure your Okta groups include `infra-dev` group — if missing, request in the same ticket.

sam: Great — filing SSO request now. Thanks everyone, feel free to close this thread once INFRA-8421 is merged and SSO approved. :pray:

leah: marking as tracked. ping here when SSO request id ready and we’ll close. :thumbsup:

sam: SSO request submitted: REQ-55894. INFRA-8421 updated with the SSO id. All good for now, appreciate the quick help!
